description: Use this when the couple asks about the gifts that their guests gave. The signed-in couple's own gifts from their Zola registry, newest first: the giver, the message, the items, the value, and the thank-you note state of each gift, with the totals and the cash available to transfer. A surprise gift that is not revealed shows no detail. For the items that guests can still buy, use zola_search_my_registry_items. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read). Do not use for how gifts work on Zola in general: use zola_search_help_articles.

limit.description: The most gifts to give, 1 to 50. The default is 25.

thank_you_note_sent.description: false: only the gifts with a thank-you note to send. true: only the gifts with a sent note. Leave it out for every gift.

name: zola_get_my_gift_tracker

outputSchema.description: The gifts that guests gave from the wedding registry of the signed-in couple

can_transfer_cash.description: False when this user does not own the registry (only the owner partner can transfer), or when no cash is ready

exists.description: False when the account has no wedding registry

gifts.description: The orders, newest first. 1 order can hold more than 1 gift item

gift_id.description: The gift for zola_mark_my_thank_you_sent. Null for a surprise gift that is not revealed

hidden_surprise.description: A surprise gift that is not revealed: no giver, message, value, or item

actions.description: What zola.com offers for the group of items that holds this item. Only the partner who owns the registry gets actions

item_id.description: The item for zola_convert_my_gift_to_credit and zola_start_my_return

gifts_available_to_send.description: Gifts that the couple can still have shipped

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

matched.description: The orders that match, before the limit

surprise_gift_count.description: Surprise gift items that are not revealed

thank_you_notes_to_send.description: Orders with a thank-you note to send

total_gift_value_cents.description: With no value of a surprise gift that is not revealed

total_gifts_received.description: The gift items, with the surprise gift items that are not revealed

title: Get My Gift Tracker
